title: Cairo Baptist Church in Ecru takes requests for free Dec. 18 meals
excerpt: Names are due by 5 p.m. Dec. 14 for free holiday meals. Cairo Baptist will offer pickup at the church and start deliveries at 3 p.m. Dec. 18.
locality: Cairo Baptist Church, Ecru, Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Cairo Baptist Church in Ecru is taking names for free holiday meals for people in need. The church will start delivering plates at 3 p.m. Friday, Dec. 18. People may also pick up a plate at the church, according to the event flyer shared Tuesday by the Town of Ecru.
The deadline to submit a name is 5 p.m. Monday, Dec. 14, four days before delivery. The church lists Wendy Fine as the contact for the meal. Requests can be made by calling or texting 662-253-2649.

For those choosing pickup, the Pontotoc County Chamber of Commerce’s church directory lists Cairo Baptist at 2610 Cairo Road in Ecru. The church’s announcement gives no delivery boundary, so anyone requesting a plate outside Ecru can check their address with the event contact.
